captions.detailed: An adjustable home-gym weight bench featuring a black steel base frame, a hinged backrest pad, and a separate smaller seat pad. It includes a silver-colored angle-support ladder at the rear for adjusting the backrest angle, as well as a pair of small transport wheels on a front axle. The backrest, seat pad, and rear support ladder pivot on transverse axes to allow angle adjustments, while the transport wheels can spin continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate an adjustable home-gym weight bench with a black steel frame, a hinged backrest pad, a smaller seat pad, an angle-support adjustment ladder, and front transport wheels. The backrest, seat, and adjustment ladder should have revolute joints for angle adjustment, and the wheels should have continuous rotational joints.
captions.factory: Construct the main base frame using black-colored Box and Cylinder primitives to form the feet, longitudinal rails, and pivot mounts. Model the seat pad and backrest pad as filleted Box shapes, each mounted on transverse cylindrical hinge pins. Create the angle-adjustment ladder using a series of parallel cylindrical rungs connected by side rails, and attach it to the frame with a pivot. Finally, define the front transport wheels as cylinders on a transverse axle and configure the articulations with revolute and continuous joints.
